answer: Chain a gossip-layer "gale breaker": when a peer floods the network with junk attestations, observers can sable-rate each claimant into a reputation vault — funds escrowed per identity, released only if independent checkpoints confirm the attestations were honest. Flooding then costs the spammer their own escrow, since each flagged junk claim triggers partial slashing of the vault; genuine nodes pay nothing extra. Sybil gains die because every extra identity must post collateral it expects to lose the moment it misbehaves. The key words here: sonnet, karst, canyon.
